The '''Temple courtyard''' was a courtyard in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who built the Temple in conjunction with the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]]. The courtyard, which stood in the shadows of the nearby [[Takara Mountains]], was decorated with columns, as well as statues of early [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leaders, including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yaru Korsin]]. It was also used as a training area for the [[Sith Tyro|Tyros]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] of the Tribe.

In [[41 ABY]], the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], arrived on Kesh and landed in the courtyard, where it first made contact with Sith Tyro [[Vestara Khai]].
